title: Gate cost bound
statement: For every natural number $\ell$, every Boolean function $p$ on Boolean vectors indexed by $\{0,\ldots,\ell-1\}$, and every map $\mathrm{wire}:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, the cost of the CNF gate obtained by relabeling the truth-table template for $p$ along $\mathrm{wire}$ is at most $2^\ell(\ell+1)$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on vectors indexed by $\mathrm{Fin}(\ell)$
